text.text: :rotating_light: Infra Projects Test Execution Failure Alert
<!channel> :warning: *ATTENTION ALL:* Automated test execution for the *Infra Projects* module has FAILED.

*:stop_sign: Currently Occurred Error:*
• *Selenium Failure:* `Expected condition failed: waiting for presence of element located by: By.id: username (tried for 15 second(s) with 500 milliseconds interval)`
• *Root Cause:* *Server SSL Certificate Expired* (`SEC_E_CERT_EXPIRED` / `NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID`).
• *Details:* Chrome blocked navigation to `https://devapp.marcoaiot.com/auth/login` due to an expired SSL certificate on the server, preventing the login form and `#username` element from loading.

*:clipboard: Blocked Test Scenarios:*
1. *Navigate to Infra Projects -> Project List* :no_entry_sign: _(Blocked / Skipped)_
2. *Create Project with Infrastructure Setup* :no_entry_sign: _(Blocked / Skipped)_
3. *Verify Project Details Page & Infrastructure Tab* :no_entry_sign: _(Blocked / Skipped)_

*:wrench: Required Action:*
• *DevOps / Infra Team:* Please renew/re-issue the SSL certificate for `devapp.marcoaiot.com` on the Nginx server.
• *Temporary QA Workaround:* Add `--ignore-certificate-errors` to ChromeOptions in test driver if local runs are needed before certificate renewal.
